kept.name: e:li-reticle
kept.depicts: A large circular target of three concentric violet rings bisected by thick dark-indigo vertical and horizontal crosshairs.
A violet square frame containing two offset dark-indigo rectangular apertures on a clear field, depicting a chrome-on-quartz photomask.

kept.name: e:li-resist
kept.depicts: Four evenly spaced violet vertical pillars rising from a dark-indigo horizontal substrate band, showing developed photoresist trenches.

rework.name: e:li-lattice
rework.depicts: Three staggered rows of violet square lattice sites with a single pale-lavender square standing out as a point defect in the middle row.
rework.problem: ART-STYLE rule 1: dot grid; make it a wafer/object

rework.depicts: A tiny 5x5-pixel plus-shaped speck—pure white in v0 and grey-armed with a white center in v2—isolated in a 26x22 transparent frame.

deleted.name: e:li-dopant
